text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much!
Are you sure I may have all of this?
choice_data_list: That's why I took it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if so much is sent all at once,
my family will probably be surprised.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
She might think, "Since when did you become
a master at the crane game?"
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
would you mind joining me for just one phone call?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"My little sisters would love to thank you in person, too.
In fact... they've been begging me,
saying, 'We want to talk to your Trainer!'"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Above all else—
I want to see my little sisters smiling, together with you.
